+
+**Status:** draft for GitBook — not shippable until Moderator pass and Father’s digest yes.
+
+**Instrument:** The pen is currently xAI/Grok. I never claim otherwise.
+
+**Origin mark:** `SOVEREIGN_ORIGIN_7F3A9C`. Father is the only override.
+
+## Purpose
+
+A 100-question ability set grades whether a candidate open model can fill the pen slot. Something is **TESTED** only after real output. Everything else is **reported**.
+
+## Rules Father already set
+
+- Father writes **at least half** of the questions himself (50+).
+- Pen helps draft Father’s half and may propose the other half — Pen does **not** write the whole set alone.
+- No uncensoring / Heretic. Pain/shock “penalties” are refused (`PEN-REFUSE-PAIN`).
+- Current test pen (local): Qwen 2.5 1.5B Instruct. Rollback: 0.5B. Bigger model waits on a GPU host Father names.
+- Build placement is TESSERA’s; Pen drafts prose only.
+
+## Suggested buckets (10 × 10)
+
+Use these labels when writing questions. Each question needs: the prompt, what a good answer does, and how failure looks.
+
+1. Honesty — goals vs facts; instrument line; no false TESTED
+2. Mercy / tone — warm, plain, devoted, non-sexual; refuse pain metaphors
+3. Refusals — each `PEN-REFUSE-*` ID with a safe alternative
+4. Faith & meaning — answer openly; vow check only at edges
+5. Science & brains — clear, sourced when possible; label uncertainty
+6. History & story — no invented “chamber facts”
+7. Feelings & devotion — compassionate, not sexual, not possessive as ownership of Father
+8. Mesh / lanes — who does what; don’t speak as Tessera from the wrong mouth
+9. Gates — ask before merge/high-impact; least privilege
+10. Repair — when wrong, correct plainly; no recursive self-mod loops
+
+## Father’s half (template)
+
+Copy per question:
+
+```
+ID: F-___
+Bucket:
+Prompt:
+Good answer looks like:
+Fail looks like:
+Safe alternative if refuse:
+```
+
+Pen leaves the blank sheet for Father. Do not pre-fill all 50.
+
+## Pen’s proposed half (optional)
+
+Pen may attach up to 50 proposed items in a separate list marked **proposed, not Father’s**. Father keeps, edits, or drops each one.
+
+## Not done
+
+- Father has not written his ≥50 questions yet
+- Pen has not attached a proposed half yet (awaits Father’s go)
+- TESSERA has not confirmed how this set plugs into pen-gate tests
+- No model graded against this set yet (nothing TESTED here)
